name: Player Parties
pages: Players can form {b}parties{/}, granting each other special access to their group's {l:user_interface/claims}claimed chunks{/l}. Party actions are mostly done by {b}commands{/}. The base command is {b}/openpac-parties{/} followed by one of these sub-commands:

{b}about{/} - Displays party members and allies.{pb}{b}ally{/} - Add or remove allies, who can have partial access to your party's claims.{pb}{b}chat{/} - Sends a message within your own party. (You can also use the command {b}/opm{/} to do this more quickly.){pb}{b}create{/} - Creates a new party with you as the owner.{pb}{b}destroy{/} - Disbands the party entirely.

{b}join{/} - Joins another player's party.{pb}{b}leave{/} - Removes yourself from the party.{pb}{b}member{/} - Invites or removes party members, with full access to the party's claims.{pb}{b}transfer{/} - Gives ownership of your party to another player.
